title: Concept: Conan requirement pinned to a user channel
description: conanfile.txt declares a `name/version@user/channel` reference, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.txt (conan).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
